newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai A shares down, B shares off 5.78 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai A shares down, B shares off 5.78 pct.

text.p: Shanghai share prices continued to tumble in late morning with the foreign currency B share index down 5.78 percent while domestic A shares fell by 5.25 percent.
The B share index fell by 5.394 points to 87.921, while the A share index was down 80.443 points to 1,450.863.

Rumours swept the market that regulatory authorities in Beijing would take steps to crack down on a boom in China's two stock markets, which have risen by more than 50 percent since the beginning of this year.

Speculation includes rumours the central government will allow some institutional shares, which are currently not traded, to be listed to absorb excess liquidity. Rumours have also suggested the authorities may narrow the daily cap on market movements.
